photo_challenges.text: Take a photo with someone you met for the first time today.
Get three people together and all make exactly the same face.
Find the biggest smile around and take a photo of it.
Photograph the most colourful ribbons or folk-costume detail you can find.
Take a photo with the musicians, or at least get the band into the background.
Photograph a group that looks like they have known each other suspiciously long.
Get two different generations into one photo.
Catch someone while they are dancing. Motion blur counts as art.
Take a photo with someone who arrived at the festival after you.
Find someone taller than you and take a photo together.
Find two people with the same or similar name and photograph them together.
Borrow a hat, wreath, or another festival accessory for a photo.
Get at least four people into one photo and make sure nobody looks normal.
Take a photo of a group toast. Non-alcoholic drinks count too; we are not running a distillery audit.
Take a photo with someone who claims they can dance. Evidence is not required.
Find someone who admits they have two left feet and take a victorious photo together.
Photograph one detail that would make you recognise this as a Moravian village festival even without a sign.
Do a respectable photobomb in your friends' photo, then take a proper one with them.
Photograph a group that looks like they have already had a very long evening.
Photograph the person who is holding the group together the most tonight.
Put at least three hands together like a sports team and take a photo.
Take a selfie with someone you do not have any photo with yet.
Take a photo that clearly shows you are actually at the Vranovice festival.
Find two people who just happen to be standing next to each other and give them a formal portrait.
